parameters.name: acceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language. Valid values:
- zh: Chinese
- en: English

parameters.name: apiId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the API.

parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the gateway. Before calling this operation, ensure that the target gateway has enabled the Simple Log Service (SLS) log delivery feature by calling UpdateGatewayFeature (name=log-config, value={"enable":true}). Otherwise, the error CloudProductInactive.LogDeliveryNotEnabled is returned.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
The dashboard name. Valid values:
- LOG: access log
- PLUGIN: plugin log

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
The dashboard source. Valid values:
- SLS: log dashboard
